svg.title: Web shop: checkout
svg.desc: Architecture diagram with 9 components and 10 connections in 3 boundaries. It is a view that shows 9 of the model's 11 components and 9 of its 11 connections. Cloud region eu-central-1: Invoices, Private network. Private network (in Cloud region eu-central-1): Shop API, Order events, Order worker, Sign-in, Data zone. Data zone (in Private network): Orders. Main path: Customer → Web shop → Shop API → Order events → Order worker → Payment provider. Most connected: Shop API (5 connections). Nothing leads into Customer. Bottleneck: Shop API; without it the diagram falls apart. Steps: 1 Customer → Web shop (places order); 2 Web shop → Shop API (submits order); 3 Shop API → Sign-in (checks token); 4 Shop API → Orders (reserves stock); 5 Shop API → Orders (saves order); 6 Shop API → Order events (order placed); 7 Order events → Order worker (delivers); 8 Order worker → Payment provider (charges card); 9 Order worker → Orders (marks paid); 10 Order worker → Invoices (stores PDF). Customer (person): connects to Web shop (step 1, places order). Web shop (frontend): connects to Shop API (step 2, submits order, via HTTPS/JSON). Shop API (service): connects to Sign-in (step 3, checks token, via OIDC), Orders (step 4, reserves stock, via SQL/TLS), Orders (step 5, saves order, via SQL/TLS) and Order events (step 6, order placed, via AMQP). Order events (queue): connects to Order worker (step 7, delivers). Sign-in (security): no outgoing connection. Order worker (service): connects to Payment provider (step 8, charges card, via HTTPS), Orders (step 9, marks paid, via SQL/TLS) and Invoices (step 10, stores PDF, via S3 API). Orders (database): no outgoing connection. Invoices (storage): no outgoing connection. Payment provider (external system): no outgoing connection.

polyline.title: Web shop → Shop API: 2. submits order [HTTPS/JSON]
Shop API → Order events: 6. order placed [AMQP]
Order worker → Payment provider: 8. charges card [HTTPS]
Order worker → Invoices: 10. stores PDF [S3 API]
